JP98.DIITA.config.menukey.description: Key to open the location toggle menu.

JP98.DIITA.menu.title: Debris in: {{location}}
JP98.DIITA.config.appearance.type.descri:
Choose between magical particles (Baubles), fireflies or dynamic.
The 'Dynamic' option creates Baubles in winter and Fireflies the rest of the year.
JP98.DIITA.config.size.fireflymin.descri: The minimum radius for firefly light.
JP98.DIITA.config.size.fireflymax.descri: The maximum radius for firefly light.
JP98.DIITA.config.appearance.style.descr: Change the appearance of Baubles between Baubles or Cosmic Dust, or combine both.
JP98.DIITA.config.frequency.mode.descrip: How often the effects appear during the current season (on randomly selected days).
JP98.DIITA.config.size.bauble.descriptio:
Adjust the size of the baubles (1-16).
Note: 1 is very small and values above 8 might be too large for comfortable viewing.
JP98.DIITA.config.lightmode.mode.descrip:
Choose the light behavior for fireflies.
Static: Emits constant, unchanging light.
Color Fade: Every so often, the color changes from the selected color to a neutral color.
Pulse: The light fades and reappears as it does in real life.
JP98.DIITA.config.colormode.mode.descrip:
Choose between predefined seasonal colors (Default) or
custom color selection (Combination of the options below).
Valid for Baubles and Fireflies.
